modern_workflow_2027.section_title: Use LinkedIn's Real Tools. Build Visibility Without Algorithm Myths.
modern_workflow_2027.website_copy: Learn how LinkedIn profiles, skills, job preferences and professional activity support career discovery. Use documented profile sections, AI-powered job search and networking features while maintaining accurate information and appropriate privacy settings.

core_competencies.details: Optimize documented profile sections—headline, summary, experience, education, skills, and location preferences—that recruiters and LinkedIn search algorithms legitimately index, avoiding unverified ranking tricks.
Leverage natural-language AI job search prompts to uncover opportunities matching your specific skills, experience level, and geographic preferences.
Make informed privacy choices regarding public vs. recruiters-only Open to Work visibility, understanding boundaries and current-employer discovery considerations.
Curate project decks, case studies, documents, and external portfolio links in the Featured section to turn your profile into an interactive work showcase.
Craft customized, respectful connection introductions, alumni outreach messages, and recruiter inquiries that respect invitation limits and avoid mass spam.
Develop high-credibility professional post drafts reflecting personal project learnings, industry insights, and career milestones without engagement pods or viral clickbait.

why_now.headline: Why Credible Professional Branding on LinkedIn Matters in 2027
points: Hiring managers and recruiters search LinkedIn profiles to evaluate candidate portfolio evidence before extending interview invitations.
Generic mass-generated AI profiles flood the platform; candidates with authentic, evidence-backed projects and thoughtful commentary stand out immediately.
Modern job discovery relies on active career preferences, automated alerts, and conversational AI searches rather than static job boards.
Professional networking built on genuine mutual value creates long-term career resilience across corporate, remote, and freelance markets.

target_audience: College students, fresh graduates, and entry-level job seekers building their first professional online footprint.
Early to mid-career professionals looking to refresh outdated profiles for executive search and recruiter visibility.
Career switchers and professionals re-entering the workforce seeking to position transferable skills credibly.
Freelancers, agency founders, and consultants showcasing client work and domain expertise to inbound prospects.
Learners who prefer a simulated, privacy-safe offline portfolio pathway without mandating live public social media posts.

required: An eligible LinkedIn account OR willingness to complete the equivalent Privacy-Safe Offline Dossier pathway.
Basic computer literacy (operating a web browser and document editing software).
not_required: No paid LinkedIn Premium subscription required (all core learning works on free accounts).
No mandatory prior work experience (freshers highlight academic projects, practical labs, and coursework).
prerequisites.recommended_preparation: A completed or drafted resume with details on education, skills, practical projects, and career interests.
prerequisites.hardware_software: A computer or laptop with internet access, web browser, and access to free Canva and Google Docs/Sheets.

portfolio.title: LinkedIn Professional Branding & Career Networking Portfolio

portfolio.description: One unified career branding portfolio containing a reviewed LinkedIn profile or offline dossier, a target-role skills map, 3 original post drafts, 5 customized networking message templates, and a sustainable 30-day activity plan.

deliverable_01.title: Component 01: Reviewed LinkedIn Profile OR Offline Profile Dossier
deliverable_01.description: A complete, professionally structured LinkedIn profile (Path A) or privacy-safe offline simulation dossier (Path B). Includes an optimized headline, engaging About section, evidence-backed experience/projects, curated skills, education, verified credentials, custom banner design, and an audit checklist.
deliverable_01.evidence: Public profile URL (Path A) OR comprehensive offline dossier document containing all section copy, banner image asset, and review notes (Path B).

deliverable_02.title: Component 02: Target-Role Skills Map
deliverable_02.description: A structured career positioning document analyzing target job requirements from genuine postings, mapping candidate competencies, identifying skill gaps, and establishing a clear professional value proposition statement.
deliverable_02.evidence: Completed Target-Role Skills Map matrix and personal positioning statement document.

deliverable_03.title: Component 03: Three Original Professional Post Drafts
deliverable_03.description: Three distinct, publication-ready LinkedIn post drafts: Post 01 (Professional introduction and career positioning), Post 02 (Project showcase or technical skills demonstration), and Post 03 (Industry reflection or professional lesson learned). Publication is entirely optional.
deliverable_03.evidence: Text drafts of all 3 posts with planned formatting, hashtags, supporting visual concepts, and clear call-to-engagement questions.

deliverable_04.title: Component 04: Five Professional Networking Message Templates
deliverable_04.description: Five customized, respectful message templates with customization fields for different networking scenarios: Template A (Connection Request Intro), Template B (Alumni/Peer Outreach), Template C (Mentor/Expert Inquiry), Template D (Recruiter/Job Opportunity Inquiry), and Template E (Follow-Up/Thank-You).
deliverable_04.evidence: Document containing all 5 templates with clear context annotations, personalization instructions, and spam-prevention guidelines.

deliverable_05.title: Component 05: 30-Day Professional Activity Plan
deliverable_05.description: A realistic, four-week activity plan covering profile maintenance (Week 1), career discovery (Week 2), professional engagement (Week 3), and review/improvement (Week 4), designed for sustainable professional growth without spam or daily pressure.
deliverable_05.evidence: Structured 30-day calendar/table specifying weekly goals, effort estimates, privacy considerations, and review milestones.

skill_boundaries.course_80_linkedin_branding: Course 80 focuses on LinkedIn profile architecture, professional positioning, job discovery, ethical networking etiquette, content drafting, and sustainable personal branding.

faq.question: Is this LinkedIn course suitable for beginners?
faq.answer: Yes. The course starts with professional positioning and profile fundamentals before covering job search, networking, content and profile review.

faq.question: What will I learn?
faq.answer: You will learn professional branding, LinkedIn profile writing, skills mapping, project showcasing, job discovery, networking and career-focused content.

faq.question: Is LinkedIn Premium required?
faq.answer: No. Core learning and portfolio requirements do not need LinkedIn Premium. Premium-specific features are discussed only where relevant.

faq.question: Can I learn without a LinkedIn account?
faq.answer: Yes. Eligible students may use a live LinkedIn account, while others can complete a privacy-safe offline simulation.

faq.question: What portfolio will I complete?
faq.answer: You will create a reviewed LinkedIn profile or offline dossier, a skills map, three professional post drafts, five networking-message templates and a 30-day activity plan.

faq.question: Will I learn to write a professional LinkedIn headline?
faq.answer: Yes. You will learn to communicate target roles, relevant skills and professional strengths accurately.

faq.question: Will I learn the About section?
faq.answer: Yes. The course includes creating a clear About section supported by genuine experience, skills and projects.

faq.question: Will I learn how to add portfolio projects?
faq.answer: Yes. You will learn to present relevant projects and use suitable LinkedIn profile and Featured content options.

faq.question: Will I learn LinkedIn AI job search?
faq.answer: Yes. The course introduces documented AI-powered job-search workflows, job preferences and role matching.

faq.question: Are LinkedIn's AI writing tools included?
faq.answer: LinkedIn's native AI profile-writing assistance may require eligible Premium access. The course offers manual and accessible AI-assisted alternatives.

faq.question: Will I learn Open to Work settings?
faq.answer: Yes. You will learn available visibility choices and privacy limitations before deciding whether to activate the setting.

faq.question: Is recruiters-only Open to Work completely private?
faq.answer: No. LinkedIn applies privacy measures but does not guarantee complete protection from discovery by a current employer.

faq.question: Will I learn professional networking?
faq.answer: Yes. You will draft professional introductions, recruiter enquiries, mentor requests and suitable follow-ups.

faq.question: Must I send connection requests to pass?
faq.answer: No. The course assesses written communication and networking strategy. Sending live requests is optional.

faq.question: Do I need to publish LinkedIn posts?
faq.answer: No. You will prepare three original professional post drafts. Publication is optional.

faq.question: Does the course teach the LinkedIn algorithm?
faq.answer: The course covers documented profile and job-discovery features, not unverified secret ranking formulas.

faq.question: Can freshers join?
faq.answer: Yes. Freshers may present education, internships, projects and genuine skills without fabricating work experience.

faq.question: Does this course guarantee jobs or recruiter messages?
faq.answer: No. Professional visibility and hiring outcomes depend on qualifications, employers, competition, professional activity and other factors.

faq.question: Is LinkedIn advertising included?
faq.answer: No. Paid LinkedIn advertising and advanced B2B prospecting are outside this course.

faq.question: What is the duration and fee?
faq.answer: The course lasts three weeks, includes 24 guided hours and has a listed fee of ₹3,900, subject to Nova Skills' verified pricing and tax policy.
